hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Intake, gas separator, and pump stages
function: The intake or rotary gas separator and the stack of impeller and diffuser stages that build the head.

tabs.overview: Each stage adds a head; stage count and type set the rate and pressure; abrasion-resistant stages for sand.
tabs.engineering: Selected on the pump curve at the drive frequency.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
